description: Creates an EmailMessage record to log email activity in Salesforce, associating it with related records. Requires EmailMessage insert permissions enabled at the org level; some orgs block this entirely.

bcc_address.human_parameter_description: Add hidden recipients who should receive the email without others seeing their addresses.
bcc_address.title: Bcc Address

cc_address.human_parameter_description: Add anyone you want to copy on the email. Separate multiple addresses with commas.
cc_address.title: Cc Address

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Email_Category__c').
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Provide custom Salesforce fields to capture org-specific email metadata. Use the API field name (ending in '__c') as the key.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

from_address.human_parameter_description: The email address the message was sent from. Use the sender’s mailbox.
from_address.title: From Address

html_body.description: HTML body of the email. If provided, takes precedence over text_body for display.
html_body.human_parameter_description: Paste the formatted (HTML) version of the email content for rich formatting. If provided, this will be shown instead of the plain text.
html_body.title: Html Body

is_client_managed.description: Whether the email is client-managed (not sent through Salesforce).
is_client_managed.human_parameter_description: Turn this on if the email was handled outside Salesforce. It helps track emails sent from external mail clients.
is_client_managed.title: Is Client Managed

is_externally_visible.description: Whether the email is visible in customer portals/communities.
is_externally_visible.human_parameter_description: Choose whether customers can see this email in portals or communities.
is_externally_visible.title: Is Externally Visible

is_incoming.description: Whether this is an incoming email (true) or outgoing email (false).
is_incoming.human_parameter_description: Select whether the email was received (incoming) or sent (outgoing) so the direction is recorded correctly.
is_incoming.title: Is Incoming

message_date.description: Date/time the email was sent in ISO format. Defaults to current time if not provided. Must be an explicit ISO datetime string; relative expressions like 'yesterday' cause validation errors.
message_date.human_parameter_description: When the email was sent. Leave this blank to use the current time, or provide the date and time if you want to set it explicitly.
message_date.title: Message Date

parent_id.description: ID of the parent record, typically a Case for case-related emails.
parent_id.human_parameter_description: Provide the parent record ID if this email belongs under a specific parent (often a Case) to keep related messages organized.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

related_to_id.description: ID of the record to associate this email with (Account, Opportunity, Case, etc.). Must reference a supported object type (Account, Opportunity, Case, Contact, Lead, etc.); unsupported object types cause validation errors or create standalone records invisible on timelines.
related_to_id.human_parameter_description: Paste the Salesforce record ID (e.g., Account, Opportunity, or Case) that this email should be linked to, so it appears on the right record.
related_to_id.title: Related To Id

status.human_parameter_description: Choose how this email should be marked in Salesforce (for example, New, Sent, or Draft). If unsure, keep the default.
status.title: Status

subject.human_parameter_description: Enter the email’s subject line so the message is easy to recognize and find later.
subject.title: Subject

text_body.description: Plain text body of the email.
examples: Thank you for your time today. Please find the attached proposal.
As discussed, here are the product specifications you requested.
text_body.human_parameter_description: Paste the email content in plain text. Use this if you don’t need rich formatting.
text_body.title: Text Body

to_address.description: Email addresses of the recipients (comma-separated if multiple).
to_address.human_parameter_description: Enter one or more recipient email addresses. Separate multiple addresses with commas.
to_address.title: To Address

name: log_email_activity

ErrorDetail.description: Error detail returned when the Salesforce operation fails.

fields.description: An array containing the API Name(s) of the field(s) related to the error. Only present when the error is related to specific fields.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: A human-readable error message explaining what went wrong and providing information about the field or object where the error occurred.
message.title: Message

statusCode.description: A string identifier for the error type (e.g., 'FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION', 'INVALID_SESSION_ID', 'NOT_FOUND', 'REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING').
statusCode.title: Status Code

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

LogEmailActivityResponse.description: Response from Salesforce after creating an EmailMessage record.

errors.description: An array of error objects. Empty array when the operation succeeds. Contains error details when the operation fails.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the newly created record. This field contains a value if the object was successfully inserted. If this field is empty, the operation was not successful.
id.title: Id

success.description: Boolean value indicating whether the operation was successful (true) or not (false).
success.title: Success

LogEmailActivityResponse.title: LogEmailActivityResponse
